subject.title: ACP parent session stuck until refresh when yielded waiting for child completion

question: Should this issue remain the broad canonical tracker for yielded-parent wake/resume behavior across ACP and native subagents?
rationale: Current source and related items show multiple runtime-specific failure modes with shared session-state/message-delivery symptoms; closing or splitting the broad tracker needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep as broad canonical
options.body: Use this issue for the cross-runtime parent wake contract and track narrow PRs or issues as partial fixes.

options.title: Split into narrower canonicals
options.body: Designate separate ACP, native announce give-up, timeout, and synthesis issues, then close this only with explicit links.

options.title: Defer broad contract
options.body: Land narrow fixes as they prove out and leave broader lifecycle semantics for later maintainer design.

recommendation.title: Keep as broad canonical
recommendation.body: Use this issue for the cross-runtime parent wake contract and track narrow PRs or issues as partial fixes.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly connected to recent native subagent active-wake and task-registry handoff changes that now define much of the remaining bug surface.
